title: Revenge participation — dead bomber throws bombs from arena edges (Super Bomberman R Revenge Cart adaptation)
intent: Per `docs/game-design/bomberman-1v1-dynamics-analysis.md §4.2`. After death, instead of just spectating, the dead bomber can LAUNCH BOMBS from arena edges into the play area. Click on a cell to launch a bomb that arcs from the nearest arena edge to that cell, lands + detonates as a normal bomb. Cooldown 5s per revenge bomb. Up to 5 revenge bombs per round. Survivors face threats from BOTH the alive opponent + dead-player bombs from the edges. Transforms 1v1 from 'orbital game' to 'alive bomber vs survivor cornered by everyone'. Solves all three user-stated problems (boring 1v1, easy escape, hard cornering — see analysis doc §4.2). Multiplayer-native: each tab's dead player can revenge-bomb independently.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/bomberman-1v1-dynamics-analysis.md §4.2`. Adopts the Super Bomberman R Revenge Cart concept (simplified — ghost camera + click-to-throw, no animated cart in v1). Highest impact-to-cost on 1v1 dynamics in the analysis batch. Cost: medium — new input handler, new bomb spawn path (revenge bombs), protocol message for multiplayer, HUD for revenge count. ~250 LOC + protocol field. Pairs naturally with power-up drop (GDP-2026-05-30-001) — kills loot the survivor AND the corpse keeps fighting.
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: existing dead-bomber spectator behaviour (per GDP-022-012 drop-in/out — already shipped). Optional but recommended sequencing AFTER GDP-2026-05-30-001 (loot drop) ships so both 1v1 systems land together.
DEAD BOMBER STATE — when alive=false flips:
Existing behaviour: ragdoll fires, despawn at 0.6s (per S105 + S108 + S128).
NEW: instead of camera transitioning to arena centre on local-player-dead, transition to REVENGE MODE.

REVENGE MODE: camera ascends to a slightly higher altitude + further-back view (orthographic if camera supports it from S163) — overview of full arena. Local player's input becomes 'click on arena cell to launch revenge bomb'.
REVENGE BOMB MECHANICS:
Click on cell (gx, gz) → launch a bomb that arcs from the NEAREST arena edge to that cell, over 0.8s, then lands + behaves as a normal bomb (fuseRemaining = 2.5s like default).
Revenge bomb has DEFAULT range = 2, max bombs cap doesn't apply (revenge bombs are separate from alive-bomber bombs).
Revenge bombs are owned by the DEAD bomber's entity (ownerId = dead bomber). Kill credit goes to them; their tally updates.
Cooldown: 5 seconds between revenge bomb launches per dead bomber.
Cap: maximum 5 revenge bombs per round per dead bomber. After cap reached, no more revenge bombs until next round.
INPUT:

Mouse click on the canvas — raycast to floor → identify clicked cell (existing if camera-from-S163 has a raycast helper, otherwise new). If clicked cell is valid (in arena bounds, not a hard block), launch revenge bomb.
Touch input: tap-on-cell → launch (same as click).
Keyboard fallback: arrow keys move a cursor highlight, Enter to launch. Useful for tests + mouse-less players.
No keybinding conflict — dead bomber's input was previously unused.
ARC ANIMATION:

Revenge bomb visible as small bomb-mesh arcing from the nearest arena edge (e.g. north edge = arena_y=0 cell in the column closest to click_gx) to the clicked cell. Parabolic arc over 0.8s. Uses Throw Glove's arc tween primitive (from S144) for consistency.
On landing: bomb spawns at clicked cell with fuse running. From this point identical to a normal player-placed bomb.
EDGE-LAUNCH SIDE PICKING:
4 arena edges (N, E, S, W). Nearest edge to clicked cell determines launch side.
Tie-break: prefer the edge opposite from the killing bomber (so revenge symbolically comes from 'the other side' of the killer's position).
VISUAL OVERLAY:
HUD: dead bomber sees a 'REVENGE MODE — 5 left, 4s cooldown' counter in centre-top of screen.
Cursor highlight: when hovering over arena cells (mouse not yet clicked), small ring at the cell. Ring pulses red if click is currently on cooldown.
Audio cue: short whoosh on launch, then standard bomb-place audio when bomb lands.
DEAD BOMBER VIEW:
Camera elevated to ~arena-overview height. Damped follow at MIN_PARALLAX from GDP-029-008 (camera barely moves; stays mostly centered for tactical clicking).
Survivor bombers visible normally. Dead bomber's own ragdoll visible (semi-transparent grayscale) until 0.6s ragdoll despawns.
Score/tally HUD continues to show with extra 'REVENGE' marker on dead bomber's row.
INTERACTION WITH OTHER RULES:
Revenge bombs interact with everything normally — kicks, chain-trigger, blast-blocks, pickup destruction, ragdoll launching of survivors.
Revenge bomb killing the LAST survivor: round resolves immediately (revenge bomb credit goes to dead bomber — they 'won' from the grave). This is THEMATIC + creates clear close calls.

Multiple dead bombers (multi-bot solo S141 — 3 bots dead + 1 human alive): each dead bot also has revenge cap of 5. With 3 dead bots = 15 revenge bombs total available. (Bots auto-launch revenge bombs, see Bot AI below.)
BOT AI INTEGRATION:
Dead bots auto-launch revenge bombs every ~5s on the cell closest to the alive survivor's predicted position (use player-anticipation logic from GDP-2026-05-29-010).
Bot personality modulates revenge accuracy:
Hunter: high accuracy — bombs the predicted player cell directly.
Coward: low accuracy — bombs cells AROUND the player (creates pressure, not direct kill).
Miner: cycles through soft-block cells — uses revenge bombs to MINE pickups for any survivors. Strange but distinctive personality.
Bot revenge cooldown: 6s (slightly longer than human's 5s — gives human a slight advantage).
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
New protocol message: revenge.launch { deadBomberId, targetGx, targetGz }. Client → server.
Server validates: deadBomberId IS dead, target cell in bounds, target not hard block, dead bomber has revenge bombs remaining + cooldown elapsed.
Server spawns the revenge bomb via standard bomb-spawn path with ownerId = dead bomber. Snapshot reflects.
Per-tab dead player can use revenge mode independently of other tabs.
Spectators in spectate-until-next-round mode (GDP-2026-05-22-012) do NOT get revenge (they're not dead — they're spectating). Distinction: revenge only for IN-ROUND deaths.
URL CONFIG:
`?revenge=off` disables revenge entirely — dead player just spectates. Useful for testing.
`?revengeCount=N` overrides 5 per-round cap.
`?revengeCooldownS=N` overrides 5s cooldown.
DETERMINISM: bot revenge timing + targeting deterministic per (dead bot id + round + scene seed + fixedUpdate tick). Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to resolve.
TESTS:
Human bomber dies → camera transitions to revenge mode + HUD shows 'REVENGE MODE — 5 left, 0s cooldown'.
Mouse click on arena cell → revenge bomb spawns at nearest edge, arcs to clicked cell, fuses + detonates.
Cooldown: launch + try-again-immediately → second launch rejected (cooldown 5s).
Cap: 5 launches → 6th rejected (cap reached).
Round resolves with kill credit to dead bomber if revenge bomb kills survivor.
Bot revenge: dead Hunter bot's revenge bombs target alive survivor's predicted cell.
Multiplayer: dead Tab A's revenge bombs visible in Tab B + Tab C.
?revenge=off → dead bomber spectates normally, no revenge UI.
PROTOCOL SCHEMA EXTENSION (schemas/protocol.schema.json):
Add 'revenge.launch' message with { deadBomberEntityId, targetGx, targetGz, sentAtTick }.
Server snapshot includes 'revenge_bombs_remaining' per dead-bomber-with-revenge.
VISUAL QA:

Solo 1v1 (1 player + 1 bot): player dies → revenge mode → player clicks on bot's predicted next cell → revenge bomb arcs in → bot dies → kill credit to player → round resolves with player's tally bump.
Connected 2-player: Tab A bomber dies → both Tab A + Tab B see revenge bombs arcing from edges, pressuring the survivor.
Sudden Death + Revenge: arena shrinking, dead player bombs corner of shrinking area, survivor cornered by walls + revenge bombs = forced engagement. Dramatic finish.
DOCS UPDATES IN THIS PR:
gdd.md §Multiplayer — note Revenge Cart equivalent as a death-engagement mechanism.
gameplay-systems.md §6 round structure — note revenge mode as a post-death gameplay state.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Animated revenge cart riding around perimeter — v1 is ghost camera + click. Cart visual is future polish.
Revenge bombs with power-ups (e.g. pierce-revenge-bomb). All revenge bombs use default range=2, no flags. Uniform.
Revenge mode for SPECTATORS (mid-round joiners per GDP-022-012). They're not 'dead', they're joining. Separate rule.
Survivors blocking revenge launches (some game has shields against this). Not in v1.
Revenge auction (bid bombs to use them). Out — simplicity.
Multi-revenge launch (queue 3 bombs at once). One bomb per click.
